# Cameo — account brief

## Who

Cameo describes itself as "Cameo | Personalized videos from your favorite stars — Book personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities." ([source](https://cameo.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is in `cameo/cameo-app` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 31 public repos and 240 followers ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).
- The iOS app has 95,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- There have been 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@cameo-maintainer-1), top contributor to `cameo/cameo-app` with 203 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@cameo-maintainer-2), 151 commits to `cameo/cameo-app` ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location listed.
- Maintainer Three (@cameo-maintainer-3), 77 commits to `cameo/cameo-app` ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). No title, team, or location listed.

## Why now

`cameo/cameo-app` last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)), and there have been 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

You have 203 commits in `cameo/cameo-app`, which has an `eas.json` and CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). The App Store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days on a repo last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)). When you ship a fix on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)), does it go out over the air, or does your workflow build and wait on store review each time?
